title: First Hip-Hop Song in the Billboard Top 40 | Little Fight NYC
description: The answer to Little Fight NYC table trivia: “Rapper’s Delight” by The Sugarhill Gang became the first hip-hop song to reach the Billboard Top 40.
heading: “Rapper’s Delight” by The Sugarhill Gang.
summary: Released in 1979. On January 5, 1980, it reached No. 37 on the Billboard Hot 100 — the first hip-hop song to enter the chart’s Top 40.

sections.heading: Hip-hop entered the Top 40.
paragraphs: The record later peaked at No. 36. It was not the beginning of hip-hop; it was the record that proved the music could become a national commercial hit.
